rows.note: Use 睇漏 as the everyday choice when someone unintentionally fails to notice something.

example.english: I often overlook details in documents.
example.traditional: 我成日睇漏文件入面啲細節。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jat6 tai2 lau6 man4 gin6 jap6 min6 di1 sai3 zit3

rows.note: Use 放過 when the speaker knowingly lets a person or fault go without blame or punishment.

example.english: You made this mistake for the first time, so I’ll overlook it and won’t pursue it.
example.traditional: 今次你第一次犯，我就放過你，唔追究喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 nei5 dai6 jat1 ci3 faan6 ngo5 zau6 fong3 gwo3 nei5 m4 zeoi1 gau3 laa3

rows.traditional: 喺 A 望落去可以見到 B
rows.jyutping: hai2 A mong6 lok6 heoi3 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 B
rows.note: Use this construction when a place at a higher position gives a view down onto something.

example.english: From the hilltop, you can overlook the whole harbour.
example.traditional: 喺山頂望落去可以見到成個維港。
example.jyutping: hai2 saan1 deng2 mong6 lok6 heoi3 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 seng4 go3 wai4 gong2
